description: Curated IPC → BNS section mappings for Nyaya-Sahayak Compare feature. Verify against official Gazette / Ministry tables before relying on them for real cases.

mappings.title: Murder
mappings.notes: Punishment for murder is largely aligned; check BNS 103 for exact wording.

mappings.title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
mappings.notes: Related provisions also appear nearby in BNS Chapter VI.

mappings.title: Attempt to murder
mappings.notes: Attempt offences are reorganised under BNS.

mappings.title: Rape
mappings.notes: Sexual offences chapter was substantially restructured in BNS.

mappings.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
mappings.notes: Related cruelty provisions continue in BNS 85–86.

mappings.title: Acts endangering sovereignty / sedition-related replacement
mappings.notes: IPC sedition (124A) was replaced; BNS 152 covers related sovereignty/security concerns with different framing.

mappings.title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
mappings.notes: Hit-and-run consequences often involve Motor Vehicles Act + BNS rash/negligent provisions. Always check both.

mappings.title: Causing death by negligence
mappings.notes: Often relevant in road-accident / medical-negligence discussions.
